title: Zeira of Diheivat
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Taanit 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.7b.4-5), raising an objection to Ravina; Hyman reports that [Rashi there](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Taanit.7b.4.1) reads Mar Zeiri of Diheivat.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Zeiri of Diheivat speaking to Ravina. Rashi gives Mar Zeiri and explains that Zeiri without that qualification lived too early to have met Ravina. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1160&lang=en) cites Rashi’s explanation.
